why: Tree with context (design/ui-layers.md). Label and Bump read a context of React's own; App provides Count with a bump function whose text is the same on both sides but whose captured step goes from 1 to 2: as a tree of names App renders the same provider and the same Bump tag (PASS-bounded), and lane A sees the captured cell differ (not proved). With --deep, Bump renders under App's provider, its useContext reads the provider's value, and a click on its button bumps App's count by a different step: WITNESS, where the older deep render (no context) read an outside draw and stayed PASS-bounded. Shell names the provider's value through a local: proved, and PASS-bounded in both modes. Frame and Board are untouched; Board at depth 2 renders Label inside Frame's section, and Label reads Frame's provider; at depth 1 Label is a handle.
